title: A Bridge Twisted Apart in a 42 Mile an Hour Wind

scenes.text: A bridge twisted like a ribbon in a 42 mile an hour wind.
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge had been open just four months in 1940.
The wind set the deck rolling in huge waves.
The motion grew and grew until the whole span ripped apart.
No people died, because it was closed to traffic before it fell.
A bridge destroyed by a breeze. Watch it twist again.

description:
The Tacoma Narrows Bridge twisted in a 42 mile an hour wind and collapsed four months after opening in 1940.
It was closed to traffic before it fell, so no people died.
The disaster changed how engineers design bridges.
What would you have done if you were on it?
first_comment: Which famous structure would you trust least in a storm?
